❄️ Why hMPV Spikes in Winter ❄️
Like flu and RSV, hMPV peaks in colder months, posing respiratory risks, especially for young children and seniors. Stay safe and informed this winter! #WinterHealth #hMPV #StaySafe #AsherLongevity
